canon_boundary: 扎拉图个人神话生物解剖未在本项目正典层冻结；本图是愚者途径高序列语汇与扎拉图身份特征的艺术解释。

character.disambiguation: 当代秘法会首领；不包含扎拉图先祖、安提哥努斯、格尔曼·斯帕罗或克莱恩。

asset.visual_event: 扎拉图以单一人形主体站在封闭门前，黑袍下半身连续解构为透明灵性丝状结构；门缝、信件与附着式回流表达神秘、信息保留和主体不稳定。

input_images.role: identity and palette reference; not retained as the final body form

provenance.prompt_summary: Vertical 2:3 painterly dark-fantasy concept: contemporary Zaratul as one connected Attendant of Mysteries mythological organism, with one mature face, black layered robes, and a lower body that unravels into translucent spirit-worm-like filaments at a sealed archive door.
provenance.negative_constraints: No claim of canonical personal anatomy; no second character, duplicate face, detached ghost body, marionette strings, puppets, tarot imagery, top hat, giant eyes, tentacles, wolf heads, gray fog throne, Sefirah Castle, complete Sequence 0 Fool authority, card frame, emblem, numeral, name, readable writing, pseudo-text or watermark.
processing_chain: image_gen generation using the prior Zaratul portrait as an identity reference
visual inspection identified a recognizable human-like afterimage
one targeted image_gen edit replacing that afterimage with attached non-anthropomorphic filaments
no frame, text or emblem compositing

engineering.color_space: RGB (reported by sips; project target is sRGB)

observations: 扎拉图主体只有一个可辨识面部；下半身丝状结构与黑袍和主体连续。
透明丝状结构读作同一生物的神话形态与延迟回流，没有独立人形。
封闭门、门缝冷光、信件和档案空间形成单一连续场景。
未观察到卡框、途径徽记、序列数字、姓名或可读文字。
未观察到木偶线、狼头、巨眼、触手簇、完整灰雾王座或源堡。
remaining_risks: 神话生物具体解剖仍是艺术解释，不能据此确认扎拉图个人的原著形态。
透明丝状结构借用了途径级灵性/身份碎片语汇，不等于已核验的个人能力清单。
这是备用物料，不代表正式卡面设计、事实批准或 release。
1024×1536 是本次原生画布，不代表项目最终 2048×3072 卡面交付。
